title: Fix it: bump the version in a deployment config, adding it if missing
basics: `update` changes a value at a path and keeps the rest of the structure: `payload update { case v at .app.version -> v + 1 }`. A case whose path is not in the data normally does nothing. Adding `!` to the end of the path creates the field when it is missing.
prompt:
The script in the editor is **almost** right. It passes on the sample and fails on a case you cannot see.

The original task was:

Every deployment increments `app.version` in the config. Return the config unchanged except for `app.version`, which goes up by 1.

Configs created before versioning was introduced have no `version` field in `app`. Those start at version 1.

Find what is wrong and fix it. You can press Run to see what it currently does.
starter:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload update { case a at .app -> { version: (a.version default 0) + 1 } }
hints: Run it on the sample first. If the sample looks right, the bug only shows on data the sample does not contain.
Ask what kind of input would break this — an empty list, a missing field, a value ordered differently.
replaces the whole app object, which drops every other field in it
solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload update { case v at .app.version! -> (v default 0) + 1 }

mustFail.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload update { case a at .app -> { version: (a.version default 0) + 1 } }

explanation.approach: `update` is the right tool for changing one field in a nested document. Without `!`, a missing field is skipped silently, which is the behaviour you want for optional data and exactly the wrong one here. With `!` the field is created, and its old value arrives as null, which `default 0` turns into a starting point.

snippets.label: A missing path is skipped
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload update { case v at .app.version -> v + 1 }

snippets.label: With ! it is created
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0

payload update { case v at .app.version! -> (v default 0) + 1 }
